_doc: Share-lost rate of a good while it travels or waits, as a continuous decay rate per year (the share lost over t years is 1 - exp(-rate * t)). Goods not listed do not spoil. Rates are labelled estimates, confidence C or D; a storage and handling model per good would derive them.

wheat_kg.source: Granary loss to pests, rot and rodents, 5-15 per cent a year (the same figure as GRAIN_SPOILAGE_RATE_PER_YEAR in sim/world/agriculture.py).

milk_kg.source: Unpreserved milk sours within a day or two without refrigeration; a rate that loses most of it in a day.

meat_kg.source: Fresh meat without salting, smoking or cold turns in days in warm weather; a rate that loses most of it in a few weeks.

hide_kg.source: Raw hides putrefy within weeks unless salted or tanned; taken as most lost over a few months.

olive_oil_kg.source: Oil turns rancid over a year or two in amphorae; a modest yearly loss.

wine_common_kg.source: Ordinary wine turns to vinegar within a year or two unless it is a strong, resinated wine.

cheese_kg.source: Salted, pressed hard cheese ripened in a cool cellar keeps a year or more; rind trimming, mites and drying lose a modest share a year (Fox et al., Fundamentals of Cheese Science, 2nd ed., 2017, on keeping quality of low-moisture salted cheese; recalled, not re-opened).

salted_meat_kg.source: Dry-salted joints kept dry and cool last a year or more; rancid fat, mould and insects take a share a year (recalled from dry-cure practice, not re-opened).

silk_cocoon_kg.source: Cocoons must be stifled and reeled within weeks or the moth emerges and cuts the thread.

silkworm_eggs_kg.source: Eggs hatch with the warmth of spring unless kept cold; held for months at most.
